# @rnw-community/rxjs-errors

> RxJS operators for error handling in observables: `filterWithException` throws instead of silently filtering, and
> `rethrowException` logs caught errors and rethrows them as a typed error. Peer dependency: `rxjs`.

Both operators default to `RxJSFilterError`; `rethrowException` rethrows errors that are already instances of the
target error class as is.

## Landing

- [readme.md](readme.md): Error class, available operators, and usage examples.

## Guides

- [Available operators](readme.md#available-operators): Overview of what each operator does.

## API reference

- [`RxJSFilterError`](readme.md#rxjsfiltererror): `Error` subclass used as the default error by both operators.
- [`filterWithException`](readme.md#filterwithexception): Passes values matching a predicate or type guard, otherwise errors the stream with a message string or message function.
- [`rethrowException`](readme.md#rethrowexception): Catches stream errors, logs `message: error`, and rethrows the original error if it is the target class or a new one with the message otherwise.
